messages:
maria: Quick check — finalizing X + LinkedIn schedule for the webinar (Wed May 6). Need final copy variants, the slide carousel from Leo, and confirmation of CTAs/landing pages. Who can pick up assets and messaging A/B by EOD?
aj: I can do copy A/B. Will draft short X variants + 2 LinkedIn intros.
sam: I can pull the webinar slide deck and export a 3-card carousel for LinkedIn. Leo, can you export hero images (16:9 and 1:1)?
leo: Yep — exporting now. Will upload to the drive in ~20.
maria: Thanks. Also want to map inbound lead routing: 1) X thread replies -> SDR triage, 2) LinkedIn comments -> nurture sequence. @aj can you add UTM params? Example: utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=webinar_may6&utm_content=variantA
aj: yup. I’ll standardize UTM and add shortlinks.

maria: Draft schedule idea (please react with :thumbsup: to confirm or comment):
```
X (short form):
 - Wed 09:00 PT: Teaser (30–40 chars) + image (hero 1:1)
 - Wed 12:00 PT: Registration CTA (variant A) + link
 - Thu 09:00 PT: Reminder CTA (variant B)
LinkedIn (long form + carousel):
 - Wed 10:00 PT: Long-form post + 3-card carousel (slide highlights + CTA)
 - Thu 11:00 PT: Speaker highlight post (pull quote + slide)
```

sam: Uploaded assets here: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-folder/webinar-may6 (hero images + carousel slides + original deck).
leo: Uploaded hero_16x9_v2.png and hero_1x1_v2.png.

maria: Copy variants — AJ, drop your two X variants inline? Keep one more playful, one more product-focused.
aj: Variant A (playful): "Big demo, small latency. Join us May 6 to see how we serve LLMs like pros. Register -> short.url/A"
aj: Variant B (product): "Production-grade LLM inference: cost, latency, reliability. Live demo May 6 — save your seat -> short.url/B"
maria: Good. For LinkedIn I'll reuse Variant B at top and then expand with bullets. Sam/Leo can you confirm the carousel order: 1) problem 2) how we solve it (runtime + routing) 3) demo + CTA?
sam: Confirmed. I'll export carousel in that order.

maria: Engagement follow-ups: SDRs will jump on X thread replies within 2 hours. For LinkedIn comments, we'll tag as 'high' if they include product interest keywords and route to nurture list (email sequence). @aj please add a tag in the shortlink so we can filter in HubSpot (e.g., &hub_tag=x_reply).
aj: Will do. Also recommending we pin a comment on X with a short FAQ + link to register to reduce repeat Qs.

leo: One quick ask on creatives — can we try a darker hero variant for the X teaser? might pop more in feeds. I'll add an alternate named hero_1x1_dark.png to the folder.
maria: Love it. A/B test for creatives: darker hero vs original. We'll track CTR per variant.

sam: Scheduling checklist for ops (copy/publish team) — copying here so we don't miss steps:
1) Final copy + variants uploaded (AJ)
2) Assets in drive (Sam/Leo)
3) Shortlinks + UTM (AJ)
4) Scheduler set (to X + LinkedIn)
5) SDR routing rules confirmed (maria)
6) Postmortem eval plan (metrics + time window)

maria: Metrics we'll track first 72 hours: impressions, CTR to landing page, registrations, replies/comments, SDR-qualified leads. Reporting cadence: morning after launch + 72h summary.

sam: One more — creatives for an A/B in the registration CTA: text A = "Save your spot" vs text B = "See the demo live". Which do we like?
aj: A/B them. I'll wire up variant tags so we can attribute in analytics.

maria: Perfect. Last call — can scheduling bot lock these times once AJ and Sam confirm?
scheduler-bot: Scheduled draft posts created: X @ 2026-05-06 09:00 PT (teaser), X @ 2026-05-06 12:00 PT (reg CTA A), LinkedIn @ 2026-05-06 10:00 PT (carousel). Pending final copy approval.
maria: Thanks — I'll review copy live in the drive in 30m. Everyone else, please add any blockers now. :calendar:
